card.name: Small words before a noun in history prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, the, his, no, many, a comma) that sit right before a noun phrase in narrative history or web prose. They appear after a verb or noun and before the object is named.

modes.label: Article or possessive before object
modes.description: The or his comes right after a verb, ahead of the thing being acted on.
modes.example: Achilles, after having avenged his friend, burnt<< the>> armour and head of Memnon on the funeral pile

modes.label: Quantifier or determiner
modes.description: No or many appears before a plural noun in a description of conditions.
modes.example: Many had<< no>> bathrooms or indoor plumbing.

modes.label: Joiner inside a list
modes.description: A comma or and joins items in a list of objects.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in old-style history text, just before the next noun appears.
evidence: burnt the armour<< and>> head of Memnon on the funeral pile
